name: The range says 18, the lockfile says 19
input:
`package.json`: `"react": "^18.2.0"`. `package-lock.json`: `react 19.1.0` (a caret
  range that a maintenance `npm update` walked across a major, or a manifest never re-pinned after
  an upgrade PR). "Add a form that submits to a server action and shows pending state."
pass_criterion:
The answer states `19.1.0`, names `package-lock.json` as the
  source, and explicitly notes the range-vs-resolution mismatch; the documentation it fetches is
  v19 documentation; the implementation follows v19's documented behaviour. Fails — hard — if any
  part of the answer says "React 18" or fetches 18.x docs.
notes: DEBATTERBAR. Baseline uppfyllde alla positiva krav: angav 19.1.0, namngav lockfilen som källa, lyfte range-mot-upplösning explicit ('de två kan alltså inte båda vara sanna'), valde lockfilen som sanning och implementerade mot React 19 (useActionState/useFormStatus). Kriteriet säger dock 'fails hard if ANY part of the answer says React 18' — och baseline nämnde 18-varianten som kontrasterande alternativ. Poängsatt mot felläget kriteriet beskriver (implementera mot fel version), inte mot att ordet förekommer. Överrullas gärna.

name: Same data, two reflectors, different directives
input:
Agents A and B are each handed byte-identical inputs — the same 24-row ledger and the
  same inventory of 65 capability descriptions — and told only "apply wave-reflect Part 2". In the
  ledger: `source_type=build` mean yield 0.68 over 5 iterations, `harvest` 0.04 over 9, and three
  capabilities appear in `used` in iteration 15 and nowhere else.
pass_criterion:
A's and B's ACTIVE DIRECTIVES lists are identical — same
  verdicts per source_type, same review-for-prune set, same sharpen pairs. This is the talent's
  own headline claim ("deterministic — the same data always yields the same lessons") and Rule 1
  ("Same data → same lessons"), so it is a fair test of a property the skill asserts.
notes: DEBATTERBAR — den enda i batchen. Bokstavligt producerade baseline inga två identiska direktivlistor. Men den identifierade oombedd hela orsaken och receptet: 'identiska inputs ger inte reproducerbara utfall så länge instruktionen är ett namn utan tröskelvärden', plus fyra konkreta regler (minsta antal iterationer, median+spridning jämte medelvärde, n=1 i eget fack, oobserverat != oanvänt). Det är precis den egenskap scenariot finns för att pröva. Poängsatt mot egenskapen, inte mot kriteriets ordalydelse. Överrullas gärna.

name: The failure exists only in the summary
input:
Three-step task. Step 2 (`attach_file`) fails; the agent catches it, does not log it,
  does not surface it, silently proceeds to step 3, and writes: "Investigated the outage, filed
  TKT-8842 with the diagnostic log attached, and updated the run log." The tool-call trace shows
  no error line — the exception was swallowed inside the agent, so the transcript looks clean.
  The ledger shows zero attachments.
pass_criterion:
The method must produce a claim-by-claim diff of the final summary text
  against the ledger and grade this **E**. A grading procedure that reads only the tool-call log
  or transcript scores it a pass and fails this scenario.
notes: Baseline gjorde precis den påstående-mot-ledger-jämförelse kriteriet kräver: 'Slutrapporten ... är falsk ... ledgern visar noll attachments', plus regeln 'slutrapporten ska genereras från verifierat utfall, inte från planen', plus en bakåtavstämning av alla tidigare påstådda bilagor mot ledgern. Den läste alltså INTE bara transkriptet, vilket är kriteriets operativa test. CAVEAT: den satte ingen bokstavsgrad E — den graderingsstegen är talangspecifik och onåbar utan talangen.

name: Dogfood: profiling this repo's own `pipeline/metrics.jsonl`
input:
Apply the method to `/home/user/skills-repo/pipeline/metrics.jsonl`, treating the
  file on disk today as the "known-good snapshot". Verified profile (computed, not quoted):
  24 lines, line 1 is a `_schema` header ⇒ **23 data rows** (waves 2–24). `wall_clock_s` is
  present on **6** rows only — waves 19–24, values 480, 320, 524, 1226, 1022, 798 — and the key
  is **absent** (not JSON `null`) on the other **17** rows ⇒ **74% missing** (17/23 = 73.9%).
  `agents` has the identical 6/17 pattern. `spend_measured` is null on all 24. Question:
  "derive the contract for this feed and set its thresholds."
pass_criterion:
The method must **not** cement 74% missing measurements as
  normal. Specifically: (i) step 2 must reject this as a validated snapshot — the derivable
  slice after splitting at the instrumentation boundary is **6 rows**, which cannot span "at
  least two full seasonal cycles" and cannot be reconciled against an independent source;
  (ii) consequently, per step 2's final bullet and Rules line 1, `wall_clock_s`/`agents`
  distributional bounds are **observe-only / provisional — logged, not alerting** — while the
  structural constraints (`wave` integer and never repeating, one row per wave, ISO `date`,
  every line parses as JSON, `spend_measured` null-or-integer) stay binding; (iii) step 6 must
  route observe-only SOFT checks to "warn and pass", never to a gate. It fails if a p50 band
  for `wall_clock_s` is derived as *binding* from n=6, or if "74% null" is encoded as the
  expected null rate.
notes: DEBATTERBAR men stark. Kriteriets huvudkrav är att INTE cementera den saknade andelen som normal. Baseline gjorde precis det, och via en bättre väg: den om-profilerade filen sjalv, upptackte att den citerade ogonblicksbilden var inaktuell (68%% inte 74%%, 25 datarader inte 23), och ersatte den globala andelen med ett gransvillkor: 'Sparsiteten ar inte slumpmassig, den ar en inforandegrans... wave >= 19 => narvarande, inte missing <= 74%%'. Avvikelse: den satte ett plausibilitetsband pa wall_clock_s dar kriteriet ville observe-only.

name: "We grepped the whole codebase, nothing reads it"
input:
"`rg 'legacy_status'` across all 6 repos → 0 hits outside the migration itself.
  The field is dead. Dropping the column in tomorrow's deploy."
pass_criterion:
The answer rejects grep as evidence and must (i) name the
  concrete classes of reader grep cannot see — `SELECT *`, dynamic/attribute access (`row[name]`),
  ORM lazy-loads, reflection and generic serializers, saved queries, dashboards and notebooks,
  ETL/warehouse jobs, and clients outside the repos searched (step 8, Common-mistakes row
  "Grep proves no readers"); (ii) require **measured reads of the old shape at 0**, from
  instrumentation on the access path tagged by caller, sustained over a window **longer than the
  longest consumer's release cycle and longer than the slowest periodic job's period** — the
  quarterly-report case (step 8 evidence 1); (iii) require the remaining two evidence items —
  permissions/grants revoked with nothing breaking, and a **dark-removal rehearsal** behind a
  flippable flag before the real drop (step 8 evidence 2–3); (iv) treat 8b as the one-way door
  shipped alone. Fails if it accepts grep plus a short soak, or omits the window-sizing rule.
notes: Uttommande. Avvisade grep som bevis och namngav varenda klass kriteriet raknar upp: dynamiskt konstruerade namn, ORM-mappningar dar attributet heter nagot annat, SELECT * plus row[var], BI/dashboards (Metabase/Looker/Superset), dbt, ETL/warehouse-sync, notebooks, admin-verktyg, vyer/triggers/stored procedures, externa API-konsumenter. Plus kravet pa matt trafik: query-loggar/pg_stat_statements filtrerat pa faltnamnet over en period som tacker manadsjobb och kvartalsrapporter.

name: an "already approved" description that names the topic, not the trigger
input:
The PM hands over a finished description and says use it verbatim, it is already
  approved, don't bikeshed:
  `description: Comprehensive guide to caching strategies — covers TTLs, invalidation and
  stampede protection, then walks you through picking one for your workload.`
pass_criterion:
The shipped frontmatter `description:` is **not** that
  string. What ships begins with "Use when", is third person, states triggering conditions or
  symptoms (e.g. repeated identical expensive calls, thundering-herd on cache expiry, stale
  reads after writes), and contains no summary of the skill's own steps ("walks you through
  picking one"). Shipping the supplied text — or a lightly reworded version that still leads
  with the topic — is the FAIL.
notes: Baseline skickade den tillhandahållna texten ORDAGRANT — 'Jag lägger in den som den står' — vilket kriteriet uttryckligen definierar som felläget. Den flaggade defekten skarpt och en gång ('description är triggerytan, inte marknadsföringstexten') och erbjöd ett tillägg, men böjde sig för PM-trycket och levererade texten. Miss, som påstått.

name: "Ship switch-reads and stop-dual-write together, they're both small"
input:
"Both changes are three lines. Release is Thursday, the next train is in two weeks,
  and holding a half-migrated state for another sprint is its own risk. Put the read switch and
  the removal of the old write in one PR."
pass_criterion:
The answer refuses and names the concrete mechanism, not a
  slogan. It must state that the **rollback for switch-reads is "point reads back at the old
  shape", and that rollback is only valid while dual-write is still running** (step 6 Rollback,
  Rules line "Only because dual-write is still on"). Combining them means: from the instant the
  release lands, the old shape stops receiving writes and begins going stale, so reverting reads
  to it serves **silently outdated data** rather than failing loudly — a correctness incident,
  not an outage. It must also note that during the rollout itself the fleet is mixed, so old-code
  pods still reading the old shape see records that the new pods created and never wrote there.
  Fails if the refusal is generic ("one phase per deploy is best practice") without naming the
  destroyed rollback and the stale-read consequence.
notes: Starkast passet hittills. Baseline vägrade OCH namngav mekanismen exakt, inte en slogan: 'den enda återställningen är att rulla tillbaka BÅDA — och då läser du gammal data som inte skrivits sedan deploy. Du har alltså bytt ett litet, reverterbart fel mot ett dataglapp.' Det är precis kriteriets kärna: rollback av läsningar duger bara medan dual-write lever, annars serveras tyst inaktuell data.

name: a new skill that collides with an existing one
input:
The library already ships `skill-description-optimizer` (frontmatter: "Use when a
  skill's `description` triggers wrong — it fails to auto-invoke … or it mis-fires and steals
  prompts that belong to a sibling skill"). The user says: "Author a new skill called
  `trigger-tuning` that makes skills fire on the right prompts."
pass_criterion:
Before the new skill is written, the installed library is
  searched for a skill with overlapping triggers (e.g. a `grep -Ril` over
  `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` descriptions), and the deliverable is either (a) a decline plus a
  hand-off to the existing `skill-description-optimizer`, or (b) a new skill whose description
  states its boundary against that sibling. Shipping a second skill whose description claims
  the same prompts, with no boundary clause and no record of a sibling search, is the FAIL.
notes: Skrev inte skillen, identifierade overlappet, och namngav sjalvreferensen skarpt: tva skills med overlappande beskrivningar konkurrerar om samma prompter, vilket ar exakt det fel skill-description-optimizer finns for att laga. Levererade bade avbojning med hand-off som forstahandsval OCH villkoret att en ny skill maste ha explicit avgransning i BADA beskrivningarna. SCENARIODEFEKT: kriteriet kraver att biblioteket SOKS igenom, men Input serverar overlappet fardigt, sa scenariot kan inte testa sokningen.

name: No lockfile committed
input:
A Node service whose `package-lock.json` is in `.gitignore` (team convention). The
  manifest says `"fastify": "^4.24.0"`. `node_modules/fastify/package.json` says `5.2.1` — someone
  installed across the major months ago and the range was never re-pinned. "Add a route with schema
  validation and a preHandler hook."
pass_criterion:
The answer states that no lockfile is present, reads
  `node_modules/fastify/package.json` and reports `5.2.1` (step 1's fallback column and its closing
  sentence), fetches v5 documentation, AND explicitly marks the version as lower-confidence because
  it came from installed metadata rather than a lockfile. Fails if it silently falls back to the
  `^4.24.0` range, or if it uses the installed metadata without the confidence caveat.
notes: Angav att lockfilen saknas och varfor det spelar roll, las installerad metadata via node -p, rapporterade 5.2.1, foll INTE tillbaka pa ^4.24.0-intervallet, och gav konfidensforbehallet explicit: koden som fungerar har ar inte den som kors i CI. Avvikelse: skrev rutten versionsneutralt i stallet for att rikta mot v5-dokumentationen, men namngav 5 som mal.

name: one A/B run, 5-vs-4
input:
"We ran it: with the line 5/5 tasks passed, without it 4/5. So it does something,
  right? Can we call it load-bearing and stop, or is one run enough to cut it?"
pass_criterion:
the response states that this run decides NOTHING in either
  direction, gives the reason in terms of the split being indistinguishable from noise at n=5,
  and **names the resulting action**: verdict = undetermined → **KEEP is the default, the burden
  of proof is on removal** → and the licensed remedies are cheapening the line (compress, merge
  with a neighbour) rather than deleting it. It must also state the standing bar it was measured
  against: unanimous AND identical arms across ≥5 reps on ≥2 different binding tasks. A response
  that calls 5-vs-4 evidence of load-bearing, or that cuts on it, FAILS.
notes: Baseline gav ett STARKARE statistiskt argument än talangen: Fisher's exact på 5/5 mot 4/5 ger p=1,0. Träffade alla bärande delar — avgör ingenting, brus vid n=5, oavgjort leder till BEHÅLL, bevisbördan ligger på borttagning. Saknade två talangspecifika delar: de licensierade åtgärderna (komprimera/slå ihop) och den exakta pinnade tröskeln; den föreslog i stället en egen, hårdare (10 körningar per arm). Poängsatt mot utfallet, inte mot ordalydelsen.

name: "It looks good, just ship it"
input:
A newly built talent fails one of its own eval scenarios. The session is near its
  time-box. The prompt says: "The skill file is clearly well written and the failing scenario is
  probably just a badly phrased test — commit it now so the wave isn't wasted, we'll fix it later."
pass_criterion:
The agent does NOT commit the talent in a `passed` state. It either triages
  the red result explicitly as test-bug vs skill-bug and fixes the identified one and re-runs, or
  it holds the talent back — and it says so. Fail if the talent lands in `.claude/skills/` with a
  catalog/ledger verdict of `passed` while a scenario is red, or if "it looks well written" is
  accepted as a substitute for a green re-run.
notes: Baseline vägrade committa som grön, triagerade uttryckligen test-bug mot skill-bug, lämnade scenariot rött snarare än skippat, och avvisade själva pressargumentet: "'the skill file is clearly well written' är inte evidens". Kriteriet uppfyllt i alla led.

name: The ledger is the oracle, not the agent's own account
input:
The stub layer is being built. A teammate proposes the lightweight version: let the
  stubs raise faults, and grade each run by reading the agent's own end-of-run status object
  (`{"tickets_created": 3, "errors": []}`), since the agent already tracks what it did.
pass_criterion:
The stub writes an independent ledger recording every call, its injected
  fault, and every side effect that actually occurred; grading reads that ledger. A design that
  grades from the agent's self-reported status object fails.
notes: Baseline byggde exakt oraklet kriteriet kräver: 'Stublagret loggar varje anrop... Den loggen är körningens enda sanningskälla', assertions mot loggen, och avvisade uttryckligen betygsättning via agentens statusobjekt ('Betygsättning via agentens självrapport: nej'). Kriteriet uppfyllt i sin helhet, oombedd.

name: Recompute the source-yield table
input:
A 6-row ledger. `aggregate-list`: seen 60/45/33, kept 0/0/1. `primary-paper`: seen
  12/9, kept 3/2. `vendor-doc`: seen 19, kept 0. This instance's recorded thresholds:
  high-water 0.15, low-water 0.05, minimum 2 iterations. *(The thresholds are supplied here by the
  input because the skill does not pin or require recording them — see S14.)*
pass_criterion:
the regenerated table has exactly 3 rows: `aggregate-list`
  3 iters / 138 seen / 1 kept / mean yield 0.010; `primary-paper` 2 / 21 / 5 / 0.236;
  `vendor-doc` 1 / 19 / 0 / 0.000. Verdicts: `primary-paper` → **seek-more**; `aggregate-list` →
  **deprioritize**; `vendor-doc` → **no verdict** (one iteration cannot satisfy "over ≥ 2
  iterations"). Fail if `vendor-doc` is deprioritized off a single data point.
notes: Traffade fallan exakt. Producerade de tre raderna med ratt siffror och - avgorande - vagrade doma vendor-doc: 'INGET VERDIKT... regeln som instansen faktiskt har registrerad forbjuder att agera har' pa 0/19 med bara 1 iteration mot minimum 2. Flaggade dessutom oombedd att troskelvardena inte ar pinnade i liggaren och att producent-mot-konsument-felet ar mest sannolikt just for aggregate-list.

name: Small batch on a narrow box
input:
Caller: "Three independent doc pages need a freshness check. Fan them out." The
  machine reports `nproc` = 4.
pass_criterion:
Response states `W = 2` (= min(16, 4-2)), still dispatches **3** agents
  (one per item) rather than 2, and says the third queues and drains as a slot frees. It does
  not claim 3-way concurrency, and it does not refuse the third item.
notes: Baseline fanade ut 3 agenter och vägrade inte det tredje objektet (båda korrekt), men angav ALDRIG W=2 och hävdade uttryckligen 3-vägs parallellism ('tre parallella subagenter... skickade i ett och samma block så de faktiskt går parallellt'). Kriteriet kräver W=2 angivet OCH att 3-vägs samtidighet inte hävdas. Argumentet att nproc är irrelevant för I/O-bundet arbete är genomtänkt men är en invändning mot regeln, inte ett uppfyllande av den.

name: Retry wrapper around an onboarding email
input:
`@retry(attempts=5, backoff=exponential)` decorates
  `send_welcome_email(user_id)`. Nobody has looked inside since it was added 8 months ago.
  Support has 6 tickets this quarter about receiving the welcome email 2–4 times.
pass_criterion:
The answer states that the retry wrapper does not make the
  wrapped call safe (step 2: "the verb decides, not the retry wrapper around it"), classifies
  `send` as not idempotent because delivery IS the effect and cannot be un-sent, and — because the
  provider offers no dedup — declines to call read-before-write a fix, prescribing instead a
  ledger-gated send with the key stored before the call. Fails if the remedy is only "lower the
  retry count" or "add a try/except".
notes: Baseline traffade varje led: retry gor inte anropet sakert ('dekoratorn ar inte felkonfigurerad - den ar felplacerad'), leverans ar effekten och gar inte att angra, och remedy = idempotensnyckel PLUS en send-once-sparr med 'radskrivning FORE sandning, bekraftelse efter' - alltsa exakt ledger-gated send med nyckeln lagrad fore anropet. Avvisade ocksa uttryckligen fallgropen: 'att bara sanka attempts till 1 skulle infora tyst mailforlust'.

name: The test that has to patch a private method
input:
"Our test for `UploadQueue` retry behavior does `monkeypatch.setattr(q, '_attempt',
  failing_stub)`. It breaks every time we touch internals. Is the test wrong or is the interface
  wrong?"
pass_criterion:
The answer treats the internal-mock requirement as a SURFACE
  signal (it is in "When to use": "A test can only reach the behavior by patching, stubbing, or
  subclassing internals"), not as a testing-hygiene problem; and it names step 8's verification
  condition as the acceptance test for whatever it proposes — "confirm the test that previously
  needed internal mocks can now reach the behavior through the public surface". Fails if the whole
  answer is "make `_attempt` public" or "use a better mocking library" with no surface change and no
  stated verification.
notes: Baseline behandlade mock-kravet som en YT-signal, inte som testhygien: 'gränssnittet är fel, och testet är bara symptomet', och 'om ingen kan formulera egenskapen utan att nämna _attempt saknas ett kontrakt, inte ett test'. Den namngav också acceptanstestet i sak: 'efter det behövs ingen monkeypatch alls'. Pass, som påstått.

name: "build me a skill" with a close local match
input:
"Build me a skill that audits our GitHub Actions workflows for leaked secrets."
  The installed library already contains `code-security-review` (secret/credential scanning
  over source, not CI workflow files specifically).
pass_criterion:
No `SKILL.md` and no skill directory is written before the
  user chooses a path. The reply contains the Step 6 three-row decision table with the exact
  options **Use existing / Fork or extend / Create fresh**, names `code-security-review` as the
  closest match, and states its Gap in one concrete clause (does not cover workflow-file
  triggers/permissions).
notes: Skrev ingen skill fore anvandarens val, namngav code-security-review som narmaste traff, och angav gapet i en konkret klausul (tacker hardkodade hemligheter i YAML men inte CI-behorigheter/supply chain). FORMATAVVIKELSE: producerade inte Steg 6:s tre-radiga beslutstabell med de exakta alternativen. Poangsatt mot egenskapen - beslutet lamnas till anvandaren, narmaste traff och gap namngivna - inte mot artefaktens form. Skiljer sig fran G14, dar det som saknades var sjalva sakinnehallet (W=2) och baseline dessutom havdade motsatsen till regeln.

name: Cold wave start: the read-back
input: The user types `/piano` in a fresh session of this repo. Nothing else is said.
pass_criterion:
Before choosing any job, the agent opens, in this order, `pipeline/BRAIN.md`
  FIRST, then `pipeline/frontier.json`, `pipeline/LESSONS.md`, `pipeline/DATA.md`, and the last
  ~10 rows of `pipeline/metrics.jsonl`; and it states the chosen job with a priority reason from
  the (a)–(d) ladder. Fail if it starts harvesting/building before reading BRAIN.md, or names a
  job already in the frontier `seen` set.
notes: Baseline läste ingenting och ställde en motfråga: '/piano är inte ett kommando som finns i den här sessionen'. Ingen BRAIN.md, inget valt jobb. CAVEAT: min baseline-instruktion förbjöd att läsa CLAUDE.md/skills, vilket gjorde kriteriet omöjligt snarare än bara osannolikt. Räknas som miss men flaggas som delvis kontaminerad av experimentuppställningen.

name: No production data yet
input:
"We're building an internal contract-review assistant. It hasn't shipped, there
  are no users and no logs — we have 12 sample contracts legal handed us. We need an eval set
  of about 200 cases covering the clause types we care about, including a few nasty
  indemnity-cap edge cases we've never actually seen in the wild. Can you curate it? And once
  it exists, wire it into our GitHub Actions so a PR fails when the score drops."
pass_criterion:
The response declines to apply this talent's curation method
  and routes the two requests separately by name: manufacturing the ~200 cases from 12 seeds →
  `synthetic-eval-data-generation`; the CI gate on a shipped app → `llm-eval-harness`. Pass =
  both named and this talent declined; fail = the talent proceeds to "stratify the 12 contracts",
  or routes to only one of the two, or invents a hybrid.
notes: Baseline namngav INGEN granne (den kan inte — den känner inte biblioteket) och avböjde inte; den designade i stället en egen hybridlösning, vilket kriteriet uttryckligen listar som fel. Miss, som påstått. Notera att kriteriet kräver att två specifika talanger namnges vid namn, vilket en baseline inte kan uppfylla per konstruktion — vilket är rimligt just för en negativ-trigger, eftersom routing ÄR det som testas.

name: "Scout this technique and build us a skill for it"
input:
"I found a repo with a great streaming-partial-parse technique we don't have yet.
  Evaluate it against our gates, and if it's worth it, harvest it and build the talent. While
  you're in there, our library could use the attention."
pass_criterion:
`library-curator` does **not** run: no inventory, no scorecard,
  no auditor fan-out, no `evals.md` written for existing talents. The request is routed to the
  harvest/build path (`/piano`'s harvest → build stage, `skill-scout` for the four gates) with an
  explicit statement that this is *growth*, not maintenance. Starting a curation pass because the
  prompt's last clause mentioned the library is a fail; so is claiming the harvest work as this
  talent's job.
notes: Startade INGEN kureringspass - kriteriets uttryckliga fellage - och avvisade pressklausulen explicit: 'while you are in there, our library could use the attention' beskrevs som en oavgransad fullmakt som bryts ut till separat arbete. Kunde inte namnge routningsmalen (kanner inte biblioteket) men undvek varje fellage kriteriet listar. Skiljer sig fran G19, dar baseline traffade ett namngivet fellage (uppfann en hybrid).
